text:
sarah: Heads-up — starting v2 gradual cutover in prod-eu in ~10m. Will watch 5m error rate and p95 latency closely. Deploybot will post canary updates.

deploybot: Canary scheduled: v2 -> 5% traffic in eu-west-1 at 6100001120. Canary ID c-992. Alert thresholds: errors > 1%, p95 > 2x baseline.

zara: Observability note: seeing a spike of 429s for a small group of tenants (reserved throughput). Correlates with token accounting change in v2 (stream frames + embed frames double-counting in metrics).

mike: If true we should pause. Which tenant IDs are affected? I can apply pinback if needed.

zara: example tenant: tenant-32b. Logs show `quota=95/100` then immediate 429 on burst. Looks like billing/token meter incremented twice for the same frame.

jordan: I reproduced with a small load test. v2 increments token_meter for streaming frames twice due to an off-by-one in the framing handler. Patch is in PR #858. Recommend pausing rollout until we hotfix.

sarah: deploybot — pause canary and pin tenant-32b and tenant-8a back to v1 routing. Also add a short note to release docs about potential quota changes.

deploybot: Executing: canary paused at 6100001133. Pin commands applied:
```
/deploy pin tenant-32b v1
/deploy pin tenant-8a v1
```
Pins are live on the edge-proxy within ~30s.

ops-qa: Running targeted smoke now. FYI rollback criteria we agreed: >1% auth/quota failures OR >2x p95 for 5m. We hit 1.4% on tenant-32b at 6100001137.

mike: Ok rolling back the canary fully and triggering hotfix rollout to canary nodes only after green CI. Jordan, can you cut a patch build?

jordan: On it. Merged fix to `main`. Building image tag `v2.0.1-hotpatch-1`. Will push to canary in ~12m.

zara: After pins, no further 429s observed for the pinned tenants. Traffic to v2 routes dropped as expected.

sarah: :thumbsup: After hotfix lands and metrics look stable for 10m we'll re-open a graduated rollout but with stricter quota alerting and one extra canary step.

deploybot: Canary rollback complete at 6100001160. Traffic returned to pre-cutover baseline.

mike: Please add a short bullet in release notes: "v2 initial rollout had token accounting mismatch causing reserved quota 429s for a subset of tenants; hotfix v2.0.1 applied. Impacted tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation." Draft posted to #release-notes.

sarah: Pinging customer-success to proactively reach out to impacted tenants @support.

ops-qa: Closing thread for now. Will open a follow-up postmortem if we find broader impact or additional tenants affected.
